newsitem.title: IRAN: Iranian cleric blasts Taleban for defaming Islam.
newsitem.headline: Iranian cleric blasts Taleban for defaming Islam.

text.p: A senior Iranian cleric on Friday accused Afghanistan's radical Islamic Taleban movement of defaming Islam by imposing "fossilised" policies.

"Through their fossilised policies, they (Taleban) stop girls from attending school, stop women from working out of homes and all that in the name of Islam," Ayatollah Ahmad Jannati told worshippers at Tehran University.
"What could be worse than committing violence, narrow-mindedness and limiting women's rights (thereby) defaming Islam?" Jannati asked.
Jannati, whose sermon was carried live on Tehran radio, is a member of the conservative 12-member Guardian Council which has veto power over parliament.

A week after their black-bearded warriors swept into Kabul in a virtually bloodless takeover, Taleban leaders are gearing up to take Afghanistan into a new era guided by their purist interpretation of Islamic Sharia law.

Shi'ite Iran has supported the ousted government of President Burhanuddin Rabbani and was hostile to the Sunni fundamentalist Taleban. The Iranian media has accused the Taleban of being manipulated by Pakistan and the United States.
